ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the diagram, the parabola $y=ax^2+bx+3$ intersects the x-axis at points $A(-1, 0)$ and $B(3, 0)$, and intersects the y-axis at point C. Connect $BC$. Find the analytical expression of the parabola.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Substitute points $A(-1, 0)$ and $B(3, 0)$ into $y=ax^{2}+bx+3$,\\
we get $\begin{cases}a-b+3=0\\ 9a+3b+3=0\end{cases}$,\\
solving this yields $\begin{cases}a=-1\\ b=2\end{cases}$,\\
$\therefore \boxed{y=-x^{2}+2x+3}$.

So the analytic expression of the parabola is y=-x^2+2x+3.
